pages: Day 110: Great creator of the world... I awoke from a deep dream. The world is profound, and deeper than the day has realized.

My presentiment has come true. The quarantine did not hold. The plague has spread across the village. People, moaning in pain, lie in the streets among their dead family members and friends. Even the iron golems seem to have changed.
I don't know what to do... I'm so lost. All these poor innocent villagers...
... Where is He? Nobody has seen Him since last night. I need to find Him. He will know what to do. Surely He will...
